items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with Lloyd Hunter for several months and then I joined another band which was a better band, by the name of Nat Towles.

ctx.x: Yes, I see. How long did you stay with Lloyd Hunter?
I stayed with Lloyd Hunter for several months and then I joined another band which was a better band, by the name of Nat Towles.
